Question_text: Yeast, a type of fungus, can respire anaerobically. This is called fermentation and results in the formation of ethanol (alcohol) and carbon dioxide. glucose → ethanol + carbon dioxide You will investigate the effects of water and ethanol on anaerobic respiration of yeast. You are provided with two beakers labelled A and B. Each beaker contains a mixture of yeast in glucose solution.
